_note: Published national plans, the only hand-entered numbers in the report. Model figures are always recomputed from the run. A year is null when the plan document does not reach it, and a country is absent when it has no plan document at all: no bar is drawn in either case. The 2025 column is the observed fleet only for Georgia (GSE); for Turkiye, Armenia, Romania and Bulgaria it is the plan document's own 2025 figure.

source.Turkiye: NEP (MENR) reference scenario, horizon 2035; 2040 not covered
source.Georgia: GSE TYNDP 2024-2034 for the base year (existing fleet, Fig. 1.4), GSE generation pipeline on G2 timing for 2030 and 2035; 2040 not covered
source.Azerbaijan: no plan document; the COP29 pledge is a single 7 GW renewable target for 2030, so no plan bar is drawn
source.Armenia: USAID LCEDP (to 2036) and EPSO base forecast (to 2040)
source.Romania: NECP 2025-2030 update (October 2024), Figure 31 (LEAP-RO); gas in 2035 and 2040 is the unlabelled residual of the total and includes minor other sources; PSH counted in Hydro
source.Bulgaria: NECP final update (2025), WAM scenario, Figure 114 read from the bars (+/-0.1 GW, calibrated on the labelled WEM Figure 91) and scaled to the Figure 115 totals; no storage line
